Tipspot started from a simple question: “Why oh why isn’t there a simple overview of what’s happening in town, based on the interests of me and my friends?”

Sure, all major cities and niches have their own websites and magazines with all kinds of event listings. But we were looking for one unified, complete and independent overview. Above all, an overview that is ‘smart’; which respects your interests and keeps you in the loop of what your friends recommend.

It became clear that this didn’t exist yet and that there was only one solution: build it ourselves. And while we’re at it, we’ll make that 'smart’ overview available on your mobile phone, so you’re always in the loop, anywhere, anytime.

Design and development started in the beginning of 2008. A complete city calendar with a special twist: a social network feature that makes the best events come forward based on your interests and 'tips’ of your friends. Many months of development later, we had the first edition of the website and mobile applications.

That’s where we are now. As said, Tipspot is a social platform. It works best when you bring some friends — or make new ones on the website. It’s improving every day and your feedback is greatly appreciated. So let’s go! Your friends are waiting inside…

Fabulously40 was created for every woman 40 and beyond, who is ready to celebrate this exciting stage of her life. Relationships with families, friends, and even ourselves are undergoing profound changes, and it seems like the time is right for something new.

As more and more women enter their fifth decade, some have forgotten about the importance of nurturing themselves. It was always about their kids, their significant others, careers, PTA meetings, soccer practices, and everything else life threw their way. For some women, it was about sacrificing all of those things in order to advance their careers and get ahead in the world. Others worked so hard to take care of people they love that they forgot to pay attention to their own needs. In the face of life’s endless demands, many women lost sight of their own personas. And in doing so, they forgot who they once were.

SOM is a school administration system for secondary education (Dutch high schools) in the Netherlands. The application registers grades, attendance, billing, education and final exams.

A fine-grained authorization implementation ensures that only the people that need particular information can see it. For example teachers will only be able to see the students they teach, guidance counselors will only be able to see the students they guide and administrative users will only see the administration parts, not the (private) guidance documents.

SOM has been in production since 2006 and was one of the first Apache Wicket applications put into production by Topicus. It currently serves over 5000 concurrent users and reaches 30000 requests per minute daily.

Development of SOM (then named Vocus) started with Wicket 1.0 and has followed all major released ever since. It has inspired many features of Wicket, for example the request logger, the render strategies, the SWARM and WASP security framework and many more. Without SOM, Wicket would not be where it currently stands.
